limits: No product editor UI or Flow/Mind UI cutover
No native immutable media snapshot; same-size edits with identical timestamps may evade detection
No browser acceptance of the full Rust media path; Blob adapter execution and wasm checks only
Snapshots <=1 MiB; legacy Storage helpers remain <=64 KiB and single-writer
Undo history, retry receipts and media capabilities are not persisted
No resource relinking or cross-origin broker
Native storage uses a trusted host directory and blocking I/O on host-managed background threads
Browser storage can be denied or evicted
Per-command commits, not an atomic whole workflow
No forced-crash/power-loss or multi-OS installation acceptance
